paragraphs: A typical morning begins with a subject-property visit to photograph the exterior, measure the floor plan, assess natural light, and review property records. Back at the office, the appraiser retrieves recent transactions and registered prices and calculates a range with the sales comparison approach. The afternoon includes writing the report, explaining unusual factors, aligning mortgage criteria with a bank relationship manager, archiving the completed report, and preparing property documents for the next assignment.
